description:
AI-powered SSH client, SFTP browser and terminal manager.

Netcatty is a beautiful, feature-rich SSH workspace built with Electron, React, and xterm.js. Built-in AI agent (Catty Agent), split terminals, vault views, SFTP workflows, and custom themes — all in one.
✨ Release Highlights
Netcatty v1.1.88 fixes MCP terminal_execute on Oracle Linux / RHEL-family hosts whose default bash prompt uses brackets.
🤖 External MCP
- MCP terminal_execute recognizes RHEL-family idle prompts like [opc@host ~]$ (including paths with spaces or ]), so commands are sent instead of timing out with “Shell prompt is not ready” (#3915 / #3914).
Code signing policy
Netcatty is applying to the SignPath Foundation open-source program. Once
approved, covered Windows release artifacts will use Free code signing provided by SignPath.io, certificate by SignPath Foundation.

and Privacy policy.
What's Changed
- fix(mcp): recognize RHEL-family bash prompts as idle by @binaricat in https://github.com/binaricat/Netcatty/pull/3915
